backup.notes: snapshot taken before the first release; filename records prev0.1.0

migration.notes: first release: migrations 0001-0007 are introduced here, schema_version=7

rollback.database: restore from verified backup only; migrations 0001-0007 are forward-only
rollback.code: no earlier release tag exists; redeploy from v0.1.0 or restore the pre-v0.1.0 backup

backfill.source: retrospective backfill from the git tag, its target commit and that commit’s src/version.ts + docs/CHANGELOG.md
backfill.checks: release-time check output was not retained; checks is intentionally empty rather than guessed
backfill.migration_applied_basis: these tags were deployed to this self-hosted instance; the migration is recorded as applied on that basis
